angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,015,026 km at 125.85 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.9458 +/- 0.0101 mas (same row, RUWE 0.92): 125.85 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.459 +/- 0.056 solar radii from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2295 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract): 1,015,026 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.168 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2295 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5730 +/- 140 K from Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2295 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Heidari et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2295 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2295.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.177, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+50 2663: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2295 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.316 dex, from Heidari et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2295 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.31387, from Heidari et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2295 (pscomppars): age 10.5 Gyr, from Heidari et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2295 (pscomppars): rotation period 78 d, from Heidari et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/A+A/694/A36/stars (Velocity curves of 7 transiting systems), column Prot: 78 d, the row 0.1 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2295 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3.9 km/s, from Heidari et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
